subject: Synapse Labs — integration deep-dive scheduling & pre-call checklist
messages:
From: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@synapselabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Weller <tom.weller@synapselabs.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: architecture deep-dive request

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the discovery session earlier this week. Our engineering and security teams would like a focused architecture deep-dive to validate network/topology constraints and authentication flows before we commit to a pilot. High-level asks:

- Walk us through Redwood’s serving topology for multi-region deployments and fallback behavior.
- Discuss KV cache and prefix-caching options for short-latency queries.
- Confirm egress/network ports, VPC peering options, and expected bandwidth profile at 5k QPS.
- Review SSO/OAuth and token lifecycle for on-prem/private deployments.

We’re aiming to schedule this the week of Sep 20 — around the 20th–24th. Could you send available slots and a short agenda? Also tell us what pre-read or artifacts you need (network diagram, sample traffic profile, current auth provider).

Attendees on our side: Leah Ortiz (prod lead), Tom Weller (infra), and one of our security engineers — I’ll add them once I confirm.

Thanks,
Leah Ortiz
Head of Product
Synapse Labs
[Attachment: synapse-discovery-notes.txt (TXT, 12KB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@synapselabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: architecture deep-dive request

Thanks Leah — this is exactly the right next step.

We can cover all of that in a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive. Proposed agenda (attached):

1) 5m intro + goals
2) 25m serving topology, routing, and fallback (multi-region)
3) 15m caching and batching strategies (KV/prefix caching examples)
4) 15m network & security (ports, VPC options, auth)
5) 10–15m Q&A and next steps/demo checklist

Available slots (PT):
- Wed Sep 22 — 9:00–10:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Thu Sep 23 — 10:00–11:15 or 16:30–17:45
- Fri Sep 24 — 08:30–09:45

Please tell us which slot works and who will join from your infra/security teams.

Pre-reads we’d like: current infra diagram (VPC/subnet map), expected QPS profile, and whether you plan egress via a single cloud region or multi-region. I attached a short agenda and our standard pre-call checklist to make the session run smoothly.

I’ve looped in Ben (tech lead for integrations) and Priyom (inference ops) who will drive the technical portions.

[Attachment: redwood-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

—
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Kimberly — thanks for the quick reply and agenda.

Quick update on attendees: Thu Sep 23 would be better for our infra lead (Tom) — can we target Thu 10:00–11:00 PT? Also, I’ll add our security engineer (Priya S.) but she may only join the first 30 minutes.

I’ll upload our infra diagram and expected traffic profile to the Drive link you provided shortly.

One question: will you want us to whitelist any specific IPs or ports before the call if we plan to run a small live inference test?

Leah

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: architecture deep-dive request

Perfect — Thu Sep 23, 10:00–11:00 PT is confirmed. I sent a calendar invite (Google Meet) to the attendees and attached the pre-call checklist; please drop your infra diagram and traffic numbers into the shared folder before EOD Tue so Ben and Priyom can prepare.

Short answers to your question about whitelisting: for the live inference test we usually do a one-minute smoke traffic from our ephemeral runner. If you want to avoid opening egress broadly, you can either:

- Temporarily allow traffic from these CIDR ranges for the test (we’ll provide exact IPs 24h before), or
- Stand up a small bastion host in your VPC that we can hit over an agreed port (we’ll use mTLS + token)

We’ll aim to demonstrate a 100-token sample (no PII) and show KV cache hit behavior. If Priya joins only partially we’ll prioritize security items in the first 20 minutes.

Attachments in this thread: redwood-deep-dive-agenda.pdf, synapse-precall-checklist.pdf

Meeting link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood_synapse_deepdive_20260923
Drive prep folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSynapsePrep

See you on Thu — Ben will run the live portion and I’ll handle network/auth.

—
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
